title: AniVira — 100 Anime Watchlist
editorial_note: This is a 100-title curation seed, not a claim that all 100 full franchises are complete or currently streamable on one platform. Muse/Ani-One entries are catalogue-listed titles; some have only specific completed seasons while the wider franchise continues. Before publishing a title as Completed, verify that every episode in the selected season/edition is available from the official publisher and mark the season-level completion accurately. The final 12 are additional completed-series/film candidates from other licensed services; verify current India rights and availability before publishing.
completion_rules: Completed season means all expected episodes of that specific season/edition are available.
Completed franchise means the anime adaptation itself has concluded; do not infer this from a completed season.
Hindi availability is edition-specific; never label an entire franchise Hindi-dubbed when only one season is dubbed.
Use official publisher uploads or licensed services only; do not embed fan reuploads.
